sections.heading: The Mandate: $130M by 2030
sections.narrative: Achieving our revenue target requires a bifurcated strategy. We must protect our existing Alternative Cloud Provider (ACP) and Managed Service Provider (MSP) base against pricing pressure from hyperscalers and vendors like Wasabi, while aggressively penetrating the cloud-native and AI infrastructure markets. We win on bundled economics, multi-tenant sovereignty, and proven performance.
sections.quote: "Data readiness is the main factor contributing to the gap between AI ambition and AI achievement... over half of organizations report that their data is not AI-ready." - Gartner, 2024

sections.heading: Market Calibration (2026-2027)
sections.narrative: Our Serviceable Addressable Market (SAM) is strictly calculated at 15% of the global Total Addressable Market (TAM), representing the specific ACP/MSP segments where we compete, entirely excluding captive hyperscaler workloads.

data.logic: Assumes 40 partners adopt GPU-tier at 5PB with $5/TB premium.
Assumes 30% of MSP base implements stricter S3 Cost API controls.
Assumes 100 partners deploy managed K8s clusters on bare-metal.
Assumes 120 partners adopt archival tiers to compete with Wasabi.

sections.heading: Execution: Product & Engineering Sync
sections.narrative: The 2026-2027 roadmap aligns product monetization goals with critical engineering stepping stones to ensure architectural viability.

timeline.business_impact: Unlocks the ability for MSPs to accurately meter, isolate, and charge for subsequent high-margin tiers.
Penetrates the $975M SAM by targeting ML pipelines, charging a 1.5x–2.0x premium for the GPU-optimized tier.
Directly counters Wasabi's price pressure and targets the bare-metal Kubernetes market to replace Ceph/Portworx.
Eliminates egress bottlenecks and solidifies enterprise Kubernetes backup adoption.

sections.heading: The GTM Shift: Benchmark-as-a-Service (BaaS)
sections.narrative: We must change our sales motion. Instead of competing on static datasheets against hyperscaler marketing budgets, we propose launching Benchmark-as-a-Service. Using our continuous internal benchmarking dataset, an Agentic AI will allow customers to input their exact workload requirements and instantly receive a validated reference architecture. We do not guess architecture or performance; we demonstrate it.
